user.title: Connect to Matrix
user.description: Log in with a dedicated non-admin Matrix bot account. The password is used only to test the connection; it is never stored.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate
reauth.description: The access token was soft-logged-out. Re-enter the bot account password to replace it. The device identity and crypto store are kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Change the homeserver URL. The username is read-only.

verify_device.title: Verify device
verify_device.description: In your Matrix client (Element), open Settings → Sessions, select "Home Assistant matrix_e2ee", and click Verify. This window waits for the verification and shows the emojis to compare.

access_controls.title: Access controls
access_controls.description: Edit access controls and the command prefix.

data_description.allowed_rooms: Comma-separated room IDs. Empty means no send and no inbound commands.
data_description.allowed_users: Comma-separated user IDs. Empty means no inbound commands.
data_description.command_prefix: Single character prefix that starts a command.

compare.title: Verify device

progress.wait_inbound: Waiting for the other device to start verification. In Element: Settings → Sessions → verify "Home Assistant matrix_e2ee".
progress.verify: Waiting for the other device to confirm the verification.

abort.no_client: The matrix_e2ee client is not running.
